title: Acids, Bases and Alkalis

outcomes.statement: Define acid, base and alkali in terms of ions in aqueous solution.
outcomes.evidence: hydrogen ions, hydroxide, not every base

outcomes.statement: Recall that acids produce hydrogen ions in water.
Recall that alkalis are soluble bases that produce hydroxide ions.
Write the ionic equation H+ + OH- → H2O for neutralisation.
outcomes.evidence: h plus plus o h minus
